title: oplismenus indicus
intro: Oplismenus indicus, commonly known as Indian thread grass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, sore throat, and respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Oplismenus indicus include its use as a demulcent, which helps to soothe and protect irritated mucous membranes, and its use as an expectorant, which helps to relieve coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of Oplismenus indicus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
